summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a Report of Voting Results for its annual and special meeting held on June 23, 2026. The report discloses the outcome of four matters voted on: election of seven director nominees (all elected with between 83% and 99.65% support), appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as auditor (99.90% in favor), approval to change the registered office province from Quebec to Ontario (99.88% in favor), and approval to change the company name from Osisko Development Corp. to Osisko Gold Group Inc. (99.46% in favor). This is a routine post-meeting disclosure under NI 51-102. No special situation or corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private transaction is involved; the filing is purely procedural with no deal terms, premiums, or strategic catalysts.
